en.description:
Watch Pixel Puzzle — Nonogram for Apple Watch

The classic nonogram puzzle game, built for your wrist. Solve pixel art logic puzzles directly on Apple Watch — no phone needed.

What is a Nonogram?
Use number clues to fill cells and reveal hidden pixel art. Each clue tells you how many consecutive cells belong in that row or column. Pure logic, zero guessing.

Built for Apple Watch
Navigate rows with the Digital Crown, tap to fill, long press to mark. Every interaction is designed for the wrist — fast, precise, satisfying.

Infinite Nonogram Puzzles
A procedural engine generates a unique puzzle every session. No puzzle packs, no repeats — just fresh nonograms every time you play. Three grid sizes:
· 5×5 — 30 seconds, perfect for a quick break
· 7×7 — A focused nonogram for your commute  
· 9×9 — Deep logic for serious puzzle fans

Daily Puzzle
A free nonogram refreshes every day. Solve it, build your streak, come back tomorrow.

Track Your Progress
Watch your daily streak. One puzzle a day builds a habit worth keeping.

Premium — One-Time, Forever
Unlock 7×7 and 9×9 nonogram grids with a single lifetime purchase. No subscriptions. No ads. Pay once, play forever.

Download free and solve your first nonogram today.
en.subtitle: Daily Nonogram Brain Puzzles
